hero.title: Dinédit
hero.tagline: Art and the table, in places we only open for one night.

identity.kicker: The alchemy of the encounter, the art of creating unique experiences.
identity.p1: We design bespoke events for companies and individuals, and run our own programme of signature dinners. Refusing off-the-shelf events, every project is conceived so that the alchemy of the encounter goes beyond the event itself.
identity.p2: Every month, Dinédit hosts an exclusive dinner in an unusual venue for around twenty guests. Each edition puts an artist, a chef and a place in the spotlight, for an intimate, convivial experience that awakens the imagination and encourages genuine exchange.
identity.closing: Dinédit turns your encounters into human, aesthetic and professional added value.

voie_diner.label: See the programme
voie_diner.text: Discover our next programme: a secret venue, a chef, an artist, around twenty guests.

voie_compose.label: Organise an event
voie_compose.text: Privatise one of our evenings, or let's design a fully bespoke Dinédit together.

items.quote: Congratulations! The evening was a wonderful experience. I love your concept. You exceeded my expectations. The menu, the wines, the service and the atmosphere were flawless.

items.quote: A huge thank you for this absolutely magical evening! You created a moment that blended art, emotion and gastronomy with real finesse. I was genuinely moved by the atmosphere you managed to create. Thank you for the connections!

items.quote: Wonderful evening! It was a total success and we thank you for it. Excellent food, superb atmosphere and a most interesting crowd. We can't wait for the next invitations.
